scripts.build:lambda: npm run build && powershell -Command "if (Test-Path deployment) { Remove-Item deployment -Recurse -Force }; New-Item -ItemType Directory deployment; Copy-Item dist\* deployment -Recurse; Copy-Item package.json deployment; Copy-Item package-lock.json deployment; Push-Location deployment; npm.cmd ci --omit=dev; Compress-Archive -Path * -DestinationPath ../lambda.zip -Force; Pop-Location"
